name: primitives-headless-disclosure
title: Headless Disclosure
description: Three bordered question rows with chevrons; clicking a row expands it to show a short answer, sliding the height open and fading the text in.
use: A FAQ or help section needs several question rows that expand and can stay open together.
avoid: It is renderless, so borders, padding, chevron and typography all need your own styling.
a11y: The demo removes the focus outline without adding a ring, so keyboard focus on the question rows is invisible. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three stacked rows on black, each a thin grey-bordered rounded rectangle with a bold question on the left and a small chevron on the right. An expanded row adds a grey answer paragraph beneath its question.
behaves: Clicking a question opens its panel: the height animates from zero to fit while the text rises and fades in through a soft mask. Several rows can stay open at once, and the chevron flips.
customise: Compose the question button and panel with your own content, and set transition, keepRendered and unmount; the height and mask animation is fixed.
weight: light: Three rows whose panels animate height and mask; idle when closed.
